scenes.title: The Curious Cat Arrives
scenes.description: A sleek black cat with glowing yellow eyes pads into the backyard. It sniffs around Halloween decorations, tail high, completely unaware of what's about to happen.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic low tracking shot of a sleek black cat with glowing yellow eyes walking through a dark suburban backyard at night, Halloween decorations, spooky yet whimsical, filmic lighting, Grok Imagine style

scenes.title: Laser Battle Erupts + Skeleton Joins In
scenes.description: The snakes explode into action, firing cyan and magenta lasers. The plastic skeleton suddenly animates, grabs a fallen laser, and starts blasting back while doing a ridiculous skeleton dance.
scenes.prompt: Wild Halloween backyard battle: glowing snakes firing lasers, animated plastic skeleton dancing and shooting back, black cat watching in horror, neon chaos, cinematic, Grok Imagine style

scenes.title: Pizza Guy Appears (Deadpan Reveal)
scenes.description: The house porch lights flick on. A bored pizza delivery guy stands on the porch holding a pizza box, completely unfazed by the laser battle happening 20 feet away.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic shot of a completely unfazed pizza delivery guy standing on a suburban porch holding a pizza box while a wild laser snake battle rages in the backyard behind him, porch lights on, deadpan expression, Halloween decorations, high contrast lighting, filmic, Grok Imagine style
